ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FixMatch uses your location while the app is open to show tradespeople and garages near you and work out the distance to them. Your location stays on your phone.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: FixMatch uses the camera when you take a picture of a problem, a quote or a job in My home. The pictures stay on your phone unless you send them yourself.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FixMatch opens your photos when you choose a picture of a problem, a quote or a job in My home. They stay on your phone unless you send them yourself. If you run a business, you can add photos of finished work to its FixMatch page, where everyone can see them.
